title: Ayta, Mag-Indi | Accent Network
text: Mag-Indi Ayta, with code “blx,” is an indigenous language spoken by the Aeta people in the Zambales region of the Philippines. Part of the Austronesian family, it has a few thousand speakers. The language is highly endangered but retains strong cultural significance for the Aeta.
